publication.verified_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(orders.channel, 'Other') AS channel, SUM(order_lines.amount) AS net_amount
FROM orders INNER JOIN order_lines ON orders.order_id = order_lines.order_id
WHERE order_lines.status = 'settled'
 AND order_lines.settled_at >= '2026-07-13T00:00:00'
 AND order_lines.settled_at < '2026-07-14T00:00:00'
GROUP BY COALESCE(orders.channel, 'Other')
